verdict.claim_boundary: Capacitated facility-location projection of public LRP instances; same-instance calibration; not full routing LRP and not okra enterprise validation. The verdict describes only this controlled cut-management comparison, and effort comparisons are restricted to instances where both policies reached the validated MIP optimum.

findings.practical_recommendation: Prefer learned cut PRIORITISATION/ORDERING with cut retention over hard cut DROPPING: aggressive active-cut budgets can break exact convergence on harder instances, while the learned policy is at least as robust as the best naive control and shows a small per-iteration wall-time edge on instances that converge.
